sanskrit_verse: nihnute likhitaṃ naikम् एकदेशे विभावितः / दाप्यः सर्वं नृपेणार्थं न ग्राह्यस्त्वनिवेदितः //
transliteration: nihnute likhitaṁ naikam ekadeśe vibhāvitaḥ / dāpyaḥ sarvaṁ nṛpeṇārthaṁ na grāhyas tv aniveditaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: When a written document is concealed or partially disclosed by one who has knowledge of its full content, that person shall render the entire document to the ruler for the sake of justice; however, what remains undisclosed shall not be accepted as valid.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in complete disclosure before the sovereign adjudicator.
Causation arises from intentional concealment of known facts.
Capacity-based responsibility is activated upon possession of full knowledge.
Restoration logic demands transparency as foundational to lawful order.
Consciousness alignment requires integrity in evidentiary presentation.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent possesses full text AND discloses only part THEN agent must disclose entirety TO ruling authority.
IF document is partially revealed AND concealment is willful THEN unrevealed portion is legally void.
IF entity holds evidence AND fails total submission THEN liability arises automatically without punitive intent.
IF disclosure is incomplete due to deliberate omission THEN system flags case for mandatory restorative review.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any litigant found withholding even one portion of a known document incurs automatic obligation to present the whole. Failure results in exclusion of unsubmitted material from consideration, ensuring that judicial integrity aligns with absolute truth-disclosure.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that concealment distorts dharma-adhikāra. Anupūrvaśaḥ indicates sequential distortion of justice when partial data is submitted. Proportional responsibility lies in full restitution through re-presentation. The non-punitive reality rule upholds that no penalty accrues—only the necessity of completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate consciousness-integrity audit of involved parties.
Require supervised resubmission of complete documentation under witness.
Assign completion process until full alignment with factual record occurs.
Reintegrate party into lawful standing once transparency is restored.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: concealment invalidates claim, transparency restores dharma, and consciousness alone adjudicates truth. All actions originate from and return to the Source.
